# 05 — Baseline existing tests

## Objective
Reproduce the starting test baseline and describe its scope and limits.
## Required context and areas
Inspect all test projects, scripts, solution, and test strategy.
## Change constraints
Do not edit tests or application code. Do not repair failures during baseline capture.
## Response format
Exact command per project; SDK; passed/failed/skipped counts; coverage if collected; test level/behaviour map; weak assertions and omissions.
## Assumptions
Mark unavailable browsers or dependencies as blocked/skipped, not passed.
## Validation and evidence
Run the relevant test commands and copy actual outcomes into test inventory and activity record. Never invent results.
